name: resourcehub
description: ResourceHub: a secure multi-tenant resource portal (TypeScript, NestJS, React, PostgreSQL RLS, Azure).

scripts.db:reset: docker compose rm -sfv postgres && docker volume rm -f resourcehub_pgdata && docker compose up -d --wait postgres && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.gen:api: pnpm turbo build --filter=@resourcehub/api... && pnpm --filter @resourcehub/api gen:openapi && pnpm --filter @resourcehub/contracts gen:client && prettier --write packages/contracts/openapi.json
scripts.sim:free: docker compose -f deploy/free/sim/compose.yml up --build -d --wait && echo Open http://contoso.localhost:8080
